classdef.name: HyphenationStyleEnum
classdef.shortdesc: Provider hyphenation styles. Currently only supported by the Duden hyphenation provider.

property.shortdesc: Hyphenates at all possible hyphenation points.

property.name: HYPH_PREFERRED_AESTHETIC
